```blade
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Short Link Component</title>
    <!-- Tailwind CSS -->
    @vite('resources/css/app.css')
    <!-- Alpine.js -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.x.x/dist/alpine.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100">
    <div wire:init="loadShortLinks" class="container mx-auto p-4">
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Create Short Links</h1>

        <form wire:submit.prevent="saveShortLink">
            <div class="mb-4">
                <label for="longUrl" class="block text-gray-700 font-medium">{{ __('Long URL') }}</label>
                <input type="text" id="longUrl" class="w-full px-4 py-2 border rounded-md focus:outline-none" wire:model="longUrl">
            </div>

            <div class="mb-4">
                <label for="shortName" class="block text-gray-700 font-medium">{{ __('Short Name') }}</label>
                <input type="text" id="shortName" class="w-full px-4 py-2 border rounded-md focus:outline-none" wire:model="shortName">
            </div>

            <button type="submit" class="bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-medium py-2 px-4 rounded">Create Short Link</button>
        </form>

        <ul class="mt-8 space-y-2">
            @foreach ($shortLinks as $link)
                <li class="border border-gray-300 p-4 rounded-md hover:bg-gray-100">
                    <p class="text-sm font-medium">{{ $link->longUrl }}</p>
                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">{{ $link->shortName }}</p>
                </li>
            @endforeach
        </ul>
    </div>

    <!-- Livewire JavaScript -->
    @livewireScripts
</body>
</html>
```
